c4ff656.summary: Re-enables the crossSectionModel family (circle, rectangle, polygon, polyline, annularSector) for OpenFOAM v2306+ and makes beamModel build per-beam cross-sections from a 'beams' list. Also adds a createMultipleBeamMesh utility.
details: Make/files: compiles crossSectionModel, circle, rectangle, quadrilateral, polygon, annularSector, polyline
beamModel.C/.H: crossSections_ PtrList and crossSections() accessor un-commented; R and A() now come from each beam's crossSectionModel
crossSection sources: run-time selection table and tmp/.ref() usage updated to the newer OpenFOAM API
createMultipleBeamMesh.C: new utility that meshes several beams, one per 'beams' entry

6e5bbc4.summary: Renames the face rotation-tensor variable in the follower-force boundary condition from Lambda to Lambdaf and looks up the 'Lambdaf' surface field, matching the solver's naming.
details: followerForceBeamDisplacementNRFvPatchVectorField.C: lookupPatchField<surfaceTensorField>("Lambdaf") replaces "Lambda"

baebd59.summary: Adds a cantilever follower-end-force test case under tutorials/ofw-paper (fields, beamProperties, load tables, Allrun/Allclean).

075bae9.summary: Whitespace-only fix (a space before '=') in the follower-force boundary condition.

d7fe04b.summary: Formatting-only change: re-indents code and commented-out lines in annularSector.C; behaviour is unchanged.

607b84c.summary: Adds the beamDisplacements function object, which writes the average W displacement (x, y, z) on a named patch to a time-history file.
details: functionObjects/beamDisplacements: new class; reads 'historyPatch' and writes Time, w_x, w_y, w_z
Ships its own Make/files and Make/options

af7f8a5.summary: Adds the beamForcesMoments function object, which writes the average force Q and moment M on a named patch to a time-history file.
details: functionObjects/beamForcesMoments: new class; reads 'historyPatch' and writes Q_x..Q_z and M_x..M_z

f6a1cc3.summary: Adds the beamEnergyData function object, which writes the beam's internal energy and its linear and angular kinetic energy each time step.
details: functionObjects/beamEnergyData: computes energies from Gamma, K, CQ, CM, U and Omega; writes beamEnergyData.dat

3273c83.summary: Adds the beamConvergenceData function object, which writes the number of Newton-Raphson corrections used in each time step.
details: functionObjects/beamConvergenceData: writes Time and nCorrectors to beamConvergenceData.dat

139421a.summary: Adds the four new beam function objects to the main library build so they compile into the wireBunchingModels library.
details: src/wireBunchingModels/Make/files: adds beamEnergyData, beamConvergenceData, beamDisplacements, beamForcesMoments

3056142.summary: Deletes the per-function-object Make folders, which are now redundant after 139421a, and adds a displacement-magnitude column to beamDisplacements output.
details: beamDisplacements.C: writes mag(avgW) with header 'mag(w)'
Removes Make/files and Make/options under all four functionObjects directories

f3fd8ca.summary: Comments out annularSector's plasticity and stress-resultant virtual functions. It also drops polygon and polyline from the library build, which the commit message does not mention.
details: annularSector.C/.H: CNM, greenLagrangianStrain, resultantForce/Moment, resultantTangentMatrices commented out
Make/files: polygon.C and polyline.C no longer compiled

e6d8425.summary: Comments out the matching pure virtual functions in the crossSectionModel base class, so derived cross-sections no longer have to implement them.
details: crossSectionModel.H: CNM, greenLagrangianStrain, resultantTotalForce, resultantForce, resultantMoment, resultantTangentMatrices commented out

ab4ee5a.summary: Comments out the same unused virtual functions (plus writeVTK) in the circle and rectangle cross-sections.
details: circle.C/.H, rectangle.C/.H: plasticity, stress-resultant and writeVTK members commented out

4a6fbcc.summary: Adds createBeamMesh, a single mesh utility that merges createCircularBeamMesh and createMultipleBeamMesh. It is mostly a reformatted copy of createMultipleBeamMesh, but places the beam axis along x instead of z.
details: createBeamMesh.C: reads the 'beams' list with crossSectionModel, length and nSegments per beam
Beam points are laid out along x; the decomposePatches option is disabled

71644d5.summary: Disables the 'objectiveInterpolation' option, an alternative rotation-update path the code marked as not working, so only the standard update remains. Also expands the reference-configuration error message to point users to createBeamMesh.
details: beamModel.C/.H: objectiveInterpolation_ member, keyword and accessor commented out; kCI() accessor tidied
coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeamEvolve.C: objective-interpolation branch commented out
coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam.C: error now warns that the deprecated mesh utilities plus transformPoints are no longer supported

28a7c84.summary: Replaces deprecated autoPtr::set() with reset() for the gravity pointer, and adds a d2dt2Schemes block to the ofw-paper follower-force tutorial.
details: beamModel.C: gPtr_.set -> gPtr_.reset
tutorials/ofw-paper/.../fvSchemes: d2dt2Schemes default steadyState

7100bc8.summary: Selects time integration from fvSchemes instead of a beamProperties 'newmark' flag, and rewrites the Newmark/Euler inertia terms in the solver.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam.C/.H: new ddtSchemeName_ and d2dt2SchemeName_; d2dt2 must be steadyState, Euler or Newmark, with ddt/d2dt2 pairs checked for consistency
newmark_ flag removed; info message prints the Newmark beta and gamma values
Evolve.C: Newmark predictor for Accl/U and dotOmega/Omega; scheme-specific inertia source and diagonal coefficients

33e3e99.summary: Cherry-pick of 71644d5 with an identical patch (same patch-id): disables objectiveInterpolation.

e84b895.summary: Cherry-pick of 28a7c84 with an identical patch (same patch-id): set() to reset(), and d2dt2Schemes added to the tutorial.

5cdb1f0.summary: Cherry-pick of 7100bc8 with an identical patch (same patch-id): fvSchemes-driven time integration and Newmark/Euler refactor.

4f4a3e6.summary: Makes Newmark configurable entirely from fvSchemes: it now requires (Newmark, Newmark) for ddt/d2dt2, with beta and gamma read there. Drag on a steady case becomes a fatal error, and the gravity/buoyancy source loop is commented out.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam.C: scheme lookups use ddt(W)/d2dt2(W); newmarkBeta(W)/newmarkGamma(W) read from d2dt2Schemes (defaults 0.25/0.5)
Allowed scheme pairs: (Euler, Euler), (steadyState, steadyState), (Newmark, Newmark)
Evolve.C: dragActive with a steady scheme now aborts; the (rho - rhoFluid)*g source loop is commented out

f9d21a6.summary: Removes unused increment accessors from beamModel and the solver.
details: beamModel.H: pure virtuals currentDisplacementIncrement() and currentRotationIncrement() removed, plus the commented objectiveInterpolation accessor
coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam.C/.H: implementations of both functions deleted

c94ad56.summary: Deletes the tutorials/ofw-paper follower-force case so it can be reorganised under tutorials/.

f534931.summary: Allows E, G and rho to be set per beam inside each 'beams' entry, or globally, but not both. The 'beams' list becomes mandatory, rho defaults to zero, and a missing-E/G error does not abort.
details: beamModel.H: E_, G_, rho_ become scalarLists; E(bI), G(bI), rho(bI) accessors feed EA, EI, GJ and the inertia terms
beamModel.C: fatal error if both local and global values are given
Old nBeams/R/U input paths and U_ commented out
Missing-E/G FatalErrorInFunction ends with endl rather than abort, so it does not stop the run

a1e5b97.summary: Fixes spacing, line breaks and wording in the local-versus-global material-property error message.
details: beamModel.C: message text only

bf468a1.summary: Aborts a transient (Euler or Newmark) run if any beam's density is zero.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeamEvolve.C: loops over beams and raises FatalErrorInFunction when rho(bI) == 0

743dda9.summary: Deletes the beamContactModel framework and all contact code: line, point, all-angle and pulley contact, plus the normal and friction contact models. It also deletes the solver's applyContacts sources and stray editor and backup files.
details: src/wireBunchingModels/beamContactModel/: entire tree removed (about 24k lines)
coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam: applyContacts.C, applyContacts.org_1 and applyLagrangeMultiplierConicalPulleyContact.H removed

8c98708.summary: Deletes the unused plasticity stress-resultant return-mapping models.
details: beamModels/plasticityStressResultantReturnMethods/: axialForce3dBending, linearElasticMisesPlastic and the plasticityStressResultantReturn base removed

c51795d.summary: Deletes two unused include fragments from the solver directory.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam: correctPlasticity.H and correctBoundaryForcesAndMoments.H removed

24ef6de.summary: Deletes unused or untested boundary conditions and removes them from Make/files. It also removes forceBeamDisplacement from Make/files, although that BC's sources remain until d11a935.
details: Removed: axialForceTransverseDisplacement(NR), extrapolatedBeamRotation, fixedPathDisplacement, fixedPathRotation, followerDisplacement, momentBeamRotation, myFollowerForceBeamDisplacementNR
Make/files: entries for the removed BCs and forceBeamDisplacement deleted

d11a935.summary: Deletes the source files of the forceBeamDisplacement boundary condition, which 24ef6de had already removed from the build.
details: fvPatchFields/forceBeamDisplacement: .C and .H removed

3c9e06f.summary: Stops writing most internal solver fields to time directories by switching them to NO_WRITE; U, Accl and Omega are among them. Also removes the unused Mref field and comment-includes headers of deleted BCs.
details: beamModel.C: beamIndicator, cellIndicator, L set to NO_WRITE
coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam.C: about 35 fields (U, Accl, Omega, dotOmega, DW, DTheta, Lambda/Lambdaf, ref*, CQ*/CM*, explicit* ...) set to NO_WRITE
Mref_ member removed; #includes for removed BC headers commented out

40b7e3a.summary: Comments out the untested axialForceTransverseDisplacementNR branch in the solver's boundary-condition coupling. The remaining supported BCs are forceBeamDisplacementNR, followerForceBeamDisplacementNR, fixedValue and momentBeamRotationNR.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeamBoundaryConditions.C: axialForceTransverseDisplacementNR block, including its nested rotation handling, commented out; rest reformatted

4934cd2.summary: Deletes the unused conicalPulley and toroidalPulley geometry classes.
details: beamModel/pulleys/: conicalPulley and toroidalPulley .C/.H removed

e60943b.summary: Renames the myFixedRotation boundary condition to fixedRotation, including its class, files and type name. Cases that use 'myFixedRotation' must be updated.
details: fvPatchFields/fixedRotation: TypeName("fixedRotation"); Make/files updated

e1220d6.summary: Normalises the Newton-Raphson solution residuals for W and Theta, making convergence scale-independent. The linear solver's true residual is printed separately, and the material and contact residual checks are dropped.
details: Evolve.C: WResidual and ThetaResidual divided by a normalising denominator; prints 'Normalised Solution Residual'
eigenSolver residual now printed as 'True Equation Residual' and no longer overwrites currentResidual
materialTol, currentMaterialResidual and curContactResidual commented out of the loop condition

ce6e4a1.summary: Deletes the beamsBunchingModel class, which depended on the removed contact code.
details: src/wireBunchingModels/beamsBunchingModel: .C and .H removed

deebde1.summary: Adds tutorials/cantilever: in-plane bending of a cantilever into a circle by an end moment (IJNME test case).

1c8429a.summary: Adds tutorials/cantileverFollowerForce: quasi-static in-plane cantilever under a follower end force (OFW paper test case 2).

98f81ed.summary: Adds tutorials/3DdynamicCantilever: dynamic 3D cantilever column under a tip force (OFW paper test case 1).

5fcc421.summary: Adds Allrun and Allclean scripts to the cantileverFollowerForce tutorial.

349bb93.summary: Adds tutorials/freeFlexibleBeam: 3D free-free flexible beam driven by end forces and moments (OFW paper test case 3).

27f789a.summary: Replaces the Newton-Raphson convergence test with a PETSc SNES-style check: absolute residual, relative residual, relative step and divergence tolerances plus a maximum iteration count. Also moves the post-solve field update into its own function.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeam.H: new checkConvergence(...) and updateSolutionVariables()
Evolve.C: new beamProperties keywords residualTol (1e-8), solutionTol (1e-10), absoluteTol (1e-30), divergenceTol (1e4), infoFrequency
Prints a residual table and the reason for convergence or divergence; evolve() returns the initial residual norm

5cae30a.summary: Updates the cantileverFollowerForce beamProperties: removes the second beam entry, uses 40 segments, adopts the new solutionTol/residualTol keywords and turns debug off.

cf11bd9.summary: Stops reading startPatchName and endPatchName from beamProperties and hard-codes them to 'left' and 'right'. Only beamModel.C changes; no test-case files are touched, despite what the message says.
details: beamModel.C: lookup of startPatchName/endPatchName replaced by fixed "left"/"right"

65e4441.summary: Deletes the deprecated createCircularBeamMesh and createMultipleBeamMesh utilities, including committed Make build artefacts, leaving createBeamMesh as the only mesh generator.
details: applications/utilities/createCircularBeamMesh and createMultipleBeamMesh removed

992731d.summary: Adds printMeshSummary.H to createBeamMesh; the file is identical to the one deleted with createCircularBeamMesh.
details: applications/utilities/createBeamMesh/printMeshSummary.H added

d237ba0.summary: Removes a local 'debug' variable read from beamProperties that duplicated the existing debug flag, and prints the total iteration count only when debug is on.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeamEvolve.C: duplicate debug lookup removed; 'Total iterations' output gated by debug

fc21172.summary: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow that builds beamFoam with Allwmake in an opencfd/openfoam-dev:2312 container on push, pull request or manual dispatch.
details: .github/workflows/build.yml added

240d493.summary: Builds with './Allwmake -j' in the CI workflow so compilation runs in parallel.
details: .github/workflows/build.yml: Allwmake -> Allwmake -j

740f36f.summary: Renames the CI build step to 'Source OpenFOAM environment and compiling beamFoam'.

05a1e59.summary: Adds a README and an allPlots.gnuplot script to the 3DdynamicCantilever tutorial, hooks plotting into Allrun, and updates beamProperties (40 segments, solutionTol, patch-name and Newmark keywords removed).

ae18c78.summary: Adds gnuplot scripts to the 3DdynamicCantilever tutorial for mesh and time-step convergence plots, and adjusts Allrun and Allclean.

a9c4091.summary: Adds reference results (an Abaqus curve and a solid-model point-displacement file) plus runSweep.sh and runTimeSweep.sh, which rerun the 3DdynamicCantilever case over several mesh sizes and time steps.

acab145.summary: Tweaks the 3DdynamicCantilever plot and time-sweep scripts. It also changes the case's time schemes from Newmark to Euler, not only adding comments, and documents optional newmarkBeta(W)/newmarkGamma(W) values.

0712571.summary: Adds a README, an allPlots.gnuplot script and Allrun plotting steps to the freeFlexibleBeam tutorial.

2698b42.summary: Relaxes freeFlexibleBeam solutionTol from 1e-13 to 1e-10 and removes the now-unused startPatchName/endPatchName entries.

3ea51a1.summary: Adds a README, Simo reference results, a displacement plot script and a mesh-sweep script to cantileverFollowerForce, and updates its beamProperties tolerances and patch-name keywords.

585f6c3.summary: Fixes the explicit inertia source for the Euler scheme: it now uses fvc::ddt(U) and fvc::ddt(Omega) instead of the Newmark-only Accl and dotOmega fields. Newmark keeps its previous terms.
details: coupledTotalLagNewtonRaphsonBeamEvolve.C: QRho/MRho built per d2dt2 scheme
updateSolutionVariables(): Euler no longer assigns Accl_ = ddt(U) or dotOmega_ = ddt(Omega)

2bc84b3.summary: Adds load-history data and an allPlots.gnuplot script to cantileverFollowerForce, plots from Allrun and revises its README.

bd3d0c7.summary: Revises the 3DdynamicCantilever README. It also switches the case's ddt/d2dt2 schemes back from Euler to Newmark, which the message ('modified README') does not mention.

d1bd069.summary: Shortens and edits the freeFlexibleBeam README.

5a07ce4.summary: Adds a README to the cantilever tutorial describing the end-moment bending benchmark, its setup and its expected results.

f216707.summary: Updates the top-level README: notes that each case has a README, adds gnuplot plotting instructions and removes outdated paths and the contact section.
